source_snapshot.title: fix(ingest): resolve tsconfig module mappings
source_snapshot.body:
Fixes #439

## Summary

Resolve local TypeScript and JavaScript imports through `tsconfig.json` and `jsconfig.json` module mappings before filename-stem fallback.

## Type
- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Test
- [ ] CI

## Changes
- Read nearest standard config files with JSONC comments, trailing commas, local relative `extends`, `paths`, and `baseUrl`.
- Select runtime or type targets according to the relationship and caller language.
- Treat a missing configured target as authoritative to prevent unrelated stem matches.
- Preserve existing fallback behavior when a configured provider exists but does not define the requested symbol.
- Match tracked paths on case-insensitive filesystems while returning their real casing.
- Keep package `exports` mappings outside this change.

## Validation

- Focused core ingestion tests: 69 passed, 1 skipped.
- Resolver and ingestion tests: 14 passed.
- Ix CLI tests: 936 passed, 1 skipped, including parser smoke tests.
- Typecheck, build, lint, and `git diff --check` passed.
- The unrelated core baseline still has six pre-existing failures involving unavailable fixtures and existing snapshots.

## Checklist
- [x] Tests pass
- [x] Smoke tests pass
- [x] No raw errors introduced
- [x] CLI output follows Ix format

## Release checklist (if merging to main)
- [ ] `ix-cli/package.json` version bumped
- [ ] After merge: tag pushed (`git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z`)
- [ ] If backend changes: `ix-memory-layer` tagged and released first
- [ ] If `docker-compose.standalone.yml` changed: verified `curl | sh` install works

comments.body:
Reviewed. The `paths` resolution and the `$`-token fix in `bf7a4b4` are both right, and the CodeQL alert on this PR is **stale** — its multi-star rationale is unreachable because `matchPathPattern` rejects a second `*` before substitution. Worth re-running the scan and dismissing.

Blocking issue: `return config?.baseUrl ? [] : undefined` makes a bare `baseUrl` authoritative. `[]` means *definitively not local*, and `baseUrl` matches every non-relative specifier — so on any repo that sets it (Next.js, CRA, Nest, most monorepo templates) every third-party import including `react` becomes an authoritative miss and its edges are dropped. Ix's own tsconfigs set neither `baseUrl` nor `paths`, so dogfooding can't see it.

Also flagging `resolveExtends`'s `existsSync`-then-read — CodeQL `js/file-system-race`, which this repo has a settled pattern for.

Both fixed, with 5 tests: **Hiro-Chiba/Ix#2**. Note it replaces your `treats an unresolved baseUrl module as authoritative` test — that behaviour is the defect. Your explicit-`paths` authority test is untouched and still passes.

Added a second commit to **Hiro-Chiba/Ix#2**: memoize the resolver.

Resolution runs per bound relationship and `index.ts` issues two full lookups of the same triple for each, so a repo with `paths`/`baseUrl` pays the walk repeatedly. Measured on a synthetic 2000-file workspace: **24.87 µs/call → 3.38 µs/call, ~7.4x**.

Worth flagging the trap, since the obvious key is wrong: `resolveCandidate` reads the source *extension* as well as the directory (a `.js` caller prefers `.js` over `.ts`). Keying on `dirname` alone serves one caller's answer to the other in the same folder and silently flips the preference order — there's a test that runs both orders plus a repeat, and it reds if the extension is dropped from the key.

Update on how this lands: **#445** now carries your commits plus the review fixes, targeting `main` directly. It's up for review by @josephismikhail.

No action needed from you. Your commits keep their authorship on that branch, and it will be merged with a merge commit rather than a squash so that stays true — when it lands, this PR closes as *merged*. The follow-up PR I'd opened into your fork is closed as superseded.

The reasoning for each fix is in this thread above and in #445's description.

Landed on `main` — your commits `7d83423` and `bf7a4b4` are ancestors of main via #445, which carried them forward with bounded/confined tsconfig reads and a fix so `baseUrl` no longer claims authority over every bare specifier (which would otherwise suppress the stem fallback). GitHub closed this one without the merged marker because the superset PR was the thing merged, but your commits and authorship are in the history. Thanks!
